spans.s: --one of the १० Pi1t2has for images, square and with no मेखल; this leads to health, wealth and happiness. M. २६२. 6, 8, १६. [page३-717+ २४]
--one of the ten sons of रौद्राश्व. भा. IX. २०. 4; वा. ९९. १२४. Vi. IV. १९. 2.
--the state architect. M. २१५. ४०.
--in एकाशिलदेश between कृष्ण and पाण्डुर Mts; in the middle is न्यग्रोधा below which is anantasada, abode of विष्णु who is worshipped by यक्षस्, Gandharvas, etc. वा. ३८. ५१-9
--a भार्गव gotraka1ra. M. १९५. २१.
(I)--a son of भद्राश्व. M. ४९. 5.
(II)--the seventh son of रौद्राश्व. वा. ९९. १२४. Vi. IV. १९. 2.
--a place sacred to शिव. M. १८१. २७.
(I)--a शुख god. Br.

(II)--a mukhya गण. वा. १००. १९.
--fourteen worlds of which seven were made and seven mind-born. भू to सत्य were created. Br.

(I)--the name of वामदेव who was prevented from proceeding with the work of creation;
1:

. ३२.
praised by the Gods before the swallowing of कालकूट.
2: Ib. २५०. ४१.

(II)--ety. from स्था, to stand; after creating Rudras, Mahadeva stood as ऊर्द्व reta (ब्रह्मचारि's life) upto the pralaya; his ten qualities are knowledge, वैराग्य, ऐश्वर्य, tapas, satya, patience, courage, the quality of creation, knowledge of self and the quality of establishing;
1: वा. १०. ६४-7; ४९. २८.
gave up protection work and hence स्थाणु.
2: Br.
--sacred to Goddess भवानी. M. १३. ३१.
--architectural science created by ब्रह्मा. भा. III. १२. ३८.
--a vessel of wood for श्राद्ध; of Udumbara tree. वा. ७५. ६७. [page३-719+ २३]
--a ritual comprising an offering of rice boiled in milk. M. २३०. ११.
